name: smwgraphics-calling-all-mixels-inspired-infernite-land
title: Calling All Mixels-inspired Infernite Land
description:
Does anyone remember LEGO Mixels? Well, I've made some graphics of the 1st world in Calling All Mixels, the Infernites Land. In this game, each tribe's land has been re-imagined specifically for that game, like how the Infernites Land has been re-imagined as a tropical vacation resort with burning hot lava instead of water, since the Infernites themselves are fire-resistant and go swim and bathe there.

Huge thanks to HaruMKT for helping me with managing the palettes' colors, I struggle a lot with managing colors, and luckily, they came in to help me, so, thanks again!
